reference.code: pub fn moving_sums(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||p[1].is_empty(){return None}let w:usize=p[0].parse().ok()?;if w<1||w>100000||w.to_string()!=p[0]{return None}let mut a=vec![];for x in p[1].split(','){let v:i64=x.parse().ok()?;if v<0||v>10000000||v.to_string()!=x{return None}a.push(v)}if a.len()<w{return None}let mut v:i64=a[..w].iter().sum();if v>10000000{return None}let mut o=vec![v.to_string()];for i in w..a.len(){v+=a[i]-a[i-w];if v>10000000{return None}o.push(v.to_string())}Some(o.join(","))}
